description: This file defines the class LocationAttribute, which represents a user-defined attribute associated with Location objects in the OpenMRS platform. It extends BaseAttribute and includes getter and setter methods for locationAttributeId and Location, as well as overrides for getId and setId methods.

classes.name: LocationAttribute
classes.description: A class representing a custom attribute associated with a Location, supporting auditing and extending the BaseAttribute class.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of this LocationAttribute.

methods.name: setLocationAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this LocationAttribute.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves the Location object associated with this attribute.

methods.name: setLocation
methods.description: Associates a Location object with this attribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the method to return the locationAttributeId as the object ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the method to set the locationAttributeId.
